Economy · India

Brokerages Recommend Top Stocks for Potential High Returns

Brokerages have identified ten stocks across sectors including autos, consumer technology, healthcare, and financial services as potential 'Buy' recommendations for the upcoming festive season. These recommendations are based on projections of returns ranging from 22% to 78%. Analysts anticipate these stocks could benefit from increased discretionary spending during the festive period, driven by improving demand, new product launches, operating leverage, credit growth, and rising consumer activity.
